labels.zh: 调查协会的科学家有灵能特质

note.zh: 隐藏事件cstorms.2230生成阿达苏星系后二选一；两条路都通向与风暴的对话。
note.en: Hidden cstorms.2230 spawns the adSul system and picks one; both lead to the conversation with the Storm.

note.zh: 最终抉择，两个结局互斥。
note.en: The final choice; the two endings exclude each other.

note.zh: 摧毁召唤器，阿达苏首都恢复为大陆星球并带有爱国研究所；设置adakkaria_world_found，可另行花费750稀有文物开启“阿达卡利亚的秘密”研究（另一故事）。
note.en: The Invocator is destroyed and the adSul capital becomes a continental world with the Patriotic Institute; sets adakkaria_world_found, which allows the separate 750-artifact "Secrets" research (another story).

note.zh: 获得遗珍“风暴召唤器”，事件链结束；阿达卡利亚母星从此无法抵达。
note.en: Gain the Tempest Invocator relic and the chain ends; the adAkkaria homeworld stays unreachable.

notes.zh: 此异常不会自然生成（spawn_chance base 0）。银河生成时选中阿达卡利亚先驱者（需“宇宙风暴”DLC）后，人类玩家在带有该先驱者标记的星系勘察行星时，on_survey_planet 的随机事件（权重25，另有“无事发生”100等）可能触发隐藏事件cstorms.200，为尚无先驱者开场的帝国生成本异常，并在30天后发送通用联络报告。
notes.en: This anomaly never spawns naturally (spawn_chance base 0). When the galaxy has the adAkkaria precursor (Cosmic Storms DLC), surveying a planet in a system flagged for it can roll hidden event cstorms.200 (on_survey_planet random_events weight 25, against 100 for nothing and the other precursors); for a player empire with no precursor intro yet it adds this anomaly and sends a generic contact report 30 days later.

notes.zh: 可选后续：拥有远古遗物DLC时，可花费750稀有文物开启研究“阿达卡利亚的秘密”（project_adakkaria_secrets_of → cstorms.2365），在另一个故事中。
notes.en: Optional epilogue: with Ancient Relics, spending 750 minor artifacts starts "Secrets of the adAkkaria Convention" (project_adakkaria_secrets_of → cstorms.2365), archived as a separate story.

cstorms.2270.evidence: events/precursor_events_cosmic_storms.txt:3850-3886 a/b/c are is_dialog_only; e creates site_adakkaria_celebration

scope.zh: 阿达卡利亚先驱者整条主线：开场异常、宣传中心、风扫命运、三咒舰队、崇高仁善协会、庆典学院与风暴对话的两个结局；秘密研究是另一个由稀有文物行动开启的故事。
scope.en: The whole adAkkaria precursor chain: opening anomaly, Propaganda Station, Windswept Fates, Fleets of the Thrice Damned, Institute of Exalted Benevolence, Celebration and both Storm endings. The Secrets research is a separate story started by an artifact action.

uncertain: Whether on_survey_planet random_events re-rolls when the chosen precursor intro event fails its trigger is engine behaviour; the guide only states the listed weights.
The Secrets epilogue (project-project-adakkaria-secrets-of, c3a) is linked only in notes; a bridge would absorb that separate root story.
